title: Wiz Kid
start: Speak to Ben on Marigold Farm in Wendlewick.

recommended.t: Stardust or wicked hood for quick teleport to the Wizards' Tower
Standard Spellbook for casting Bones to Bananas and Telekinetic Grab

rewards.t: Ability to teleport to Marigold Farm via the Wendlewick Teleport spell

steps.t: Talk to Ben at Marigold Farm in Havenhythe. [Chat: Accept › ~]
Talk to him again to give him the runes. [Chat: 1 Yes, I brought enough runes for me too.]
Talk to him again to continue the quest. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Cast the Wendlewick Teleport spell, and talk to him again.
Enter the windmill to the north, climb up the ladder to the top floor, and talk to him.
Go back to the bottom floor and talk to him outside.
Go to the farmhouse to the south and take the flowers off the counter in the eastern room.
Place the flowers on the stool east of Ben, then cast Telekinetic Grab on them.
Place the flowers back on the stool and talk to Ben.
If you don't already have bones, head to the western side of the farmhouse and dig in the dirt mound for 2 sets of crow bones.
Place a bone on the stool near Ben, then cast the Bones to Bananas spell.
Go to the Wizards' Tower floor 3 and talk to Archmage Sedridor to the southwest. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Wiz Kid'.]

sub.t: If unlocked, the teleport option on stardust in the currency pouch places you near Archmage Sedridor.

p: Ben shows Wizard Isidor his attempt at Bones to Bananas.

steps.t: Go down one floor and talk to Wizard Isidor to the west. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Wiz Kid'.]
Return to Ben and talk to him or Wizard Isidor. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
